name: Hidden Enemies
summary: Thrall sends you against the Searing Blade beneath Orgrimmar. After tricking Neeru Fireblade into believing you are an ally, he sends you into Ragefire Chasm to assassinate the cult's top commanders.

sections.title: A Cancer Beneath the Streets
sections.body: Orgrimmar was built as a haven for a free Orcish race, but its foundations conceal an old demonic threat. Beneath the markets, the Cleft of Shadow opens onto the tunnels of Ragefire Chasm. In those volcanic depths, remnants of the Shadow Council called the Searing Blade gather strength. They practice dark arts and scheme to seize the young Horde from within its own capital.

sections.title: Playing the Double Agent
sections.body: A direct assault without intelligence would leave the Shadow Council's network intact. Thrall uses you to draw information from Neeru Fireblade, a warlock in the Cleft of Shadow who seems willing to cooperate. Neeru believes you share the cult's cause and gives up the names of its underground leaders: Bazzalan, a corrupt satyr, and Jergosh the Invoker, a warlock.

sections.title: Decapitating the Searing Blade
sections.body: Thrall sends you into Ragefire Chasm to kill Bazzalan and Jergosh, throwing the cultists into chaos. The killings must remain deniable, so Neeru cannot learn who carried them out. Thrall plans to keep the warlock under watch. Removing the leaders sends shock through the cult and gives the Horde's young city precious breathing room.

faq.q: Who orders the hit in Hidden Enemies?
faq.answer: Warchief Thrall orders the attack from the Valley of Wisdom in Orgrimmar. He trusts you with sensitive work to secure the city's underbelly.

faq.q: Why doesn't Thrall just execute Neeru Fireblade?
faq.answer: Thrall keeps Neeru alive under surveillance. Knowing the traitor lets the Warchief's scouts watch the Shadow Council's communications and anticipate plots, rather than leave room for a hidden replacement.

faq.q: Where are Bazzalan and Jergosh the Invoker located?
faq.answer: Bazzalan and Jergosh the Invoker are deep within Ragefire Chasm, reached through the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar. Jergosh commands the cultists from a volcanic ledge, while Bazzalan lurks in a nearby elevated cavern.

The Searing Blade is a local sect aligned with the Burning Blade and Shadow Council. Its members worship demonic powers and practice fel magic beneath Orgrimmar, seeking to overthrow Thrall and enslave the Horde again.

faq.q: Why is a satyr like Bazzalan working beneath an Orc city?
aliases: why is there a satyr in orgrimmar
faq.answer: Satyrs are ancient servants of the Burning Legion. Bazzalan works beneath the Orc city as a demonic handler and instigator, guiding the Searing Blade's mortal cultists to carry out the Legion's will under Thrall's feet.

faq.q: How does this quest fit into the broader Ragefire Chasm run?
faq.answer: Hidden Enemies brings Thrall's infiltration chain to its climax. It joins other Ragefire Chasm assignments that target the dungeon's chief humanoid foes in one coordinated strike.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you face demonic corruption in the heart of Durotar, threatening all the new Horde fought to establish. Cleansing Ragefire Chasm helps preserve its hard-won freedom.
As an orc seeking redemption from the blood-haze, you face the Shadow Council's remnants beneath Orgrimmar. Their destruction is a matter of cultural survival and honor.
As a warlock, you know Thrall tolerates dark arts in the Horde's defense. Jergosh and the Searing Blade have instead sworn themselves to demonic masters, betraying the Horde.
